1937, June
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK, NO. 6.
Page 189 Cont.
June 2 Kalen Bouhana - 26 - Two yrs in Kiefer's T.B. enrolled last yr. and now looking for work looks O.K. - looking for work out doors ...
Page 190
June 2 Catherine Connolly - 70 - Kidney tro. and threatened cancer. Drs. refuse to tell what Xray shows.
Eugenia Blass - 58 - of Toledo, 0. - blind now 7 yrs. otherwise healthy and has great faith. Three of a family T. B .. Card Party ... Entertainment 11th.
Page 191 June 7 Mrs. Marie Light - 41 - Stomach cancer has two young children and husband depending on her - and her own mother. Enrolled manifold - also Poor Souls.
Mrs. Rita Toomey - 37 - losing sight
E'd Brennan - 36 - Sioux City, Iowa - given up six months ago - stom- ach cancer - slowly improving.
Harry Dettloff - 36 - nervous breakdown - and stroke - three years ago.
7 Mrs. May Snyder - 45 - bowel cancer - Drs. want operation - Patient has two young children and non-Catholic husband - enrolled To-day
Louis Jolly - 36 - threatened with foreclosure .... has family of 8 - doctor bills etc .... 3 % per month.
Dust Storms in Montant .no rain - one family put 1200 bush- els of grain as seed. Last friday looked like cyclone .... went down in cellar.
Mrs. 0gg - 46 - stomach-cancer, hopeless to "science," & Drs. . . . 6 mo. since Drs. discovered. . . Page 192 June 7 Leo Devriendt - 27 - Thanks for PP. Was threatened with stomach can- cer with which his father died. Enrolled two yrs. ago and prayed for - working now.
